note: Every Kalshi futures market the simulator may compare against, mapped BY A PERSON to one exact simulated outcome after reading the market's settlement rules. A market that is not listed here is never compared. Fuzzy or automatic matches are never published: simulator/src/cli/kalshi_discover.ts lists candidates for review and writes nothing here. No mapping is listed yet: Kalshi's API was not reachable from the build environment, so no market's rules could be read and verified.

thresholds.note: max_reference_spread follows public.kalshi_rule('max_spread') (0.06). A flag needs a fresh quote, a verified mapping, the ask size at exec_quantity, a verified fee schedule, an executable edge of at least min_exec_edge_pp points and at least min_edge_mcse_multiple Monte Carlo SEs.

fees.formula: fee per order = ceil_to_cent(rate x contracts x P x (1 - P)), P the price in dollars
fees.source: Kalshi fee schedule as recalled, NOT VERIFIED: kalshi.com was not reachable from the build environment. Until a person verifies the schedule for these series and sets verified true with a source URL and date, every executable comparison is labelled pre-fee and no opportunity is flagged.
